Lessons.Title: A New Kind of Number
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Justify that $x^2=\text-1$ has no real solutions by using a graph of $y=x^2$. Represent imaginary numbers visually with the imaginary number line.
The square of a real number is never negative; x²=-1 has no real root. Define a complex imaginary unit i such that i²=-1.

Source activity 10.1: Numbers Are Inventions: Jada was helping her cousin with his math homework. He was supposed to solve the equation \(8 + x = 5\).
